title: Second derivative at a local maximum
source_anchor: standard second-order necessary conditions and unit-sphere exponential curves
target_statement: For a real function continuous at a local maximum, the second derivative represented by deriv (deriv f) is nonpositive. Formula: x\text{ local max of }f,\ f\text{ continuous at }x\Longrightarrow (\operatorname{deriv}\operatorname{deriv}f)(x)\le0
